To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The photo-induced effects of hybrid organo TiO 2 -SiO 2 sol–gel thin films have been investigated using UV and X-ray photons.

(1) TiO2-SO2 sol–gel thin layers are sensitive to UV and hard X-ray radiation; (2) the addition of a photo-initiator increases the photosensitivity of sol–gel layers to UV and X-ray radiation; and (3) hard X-ray radiation can be used to densify sol–gel thin films.

X-ray photons can be used as an alternative light source to densify sol–gel-based hybrid TiO2–SiO2 layers and that the photo-initiator DMPA is an effective way to enhance the photosensitivity of sol–gel-based TiO2–silica layers.
